summary: Bioceres Crop Solutions filed a 6-K disclosing receipt on September 15, 2026 of a Nasdaq letter approving transfer of its ordinary shares from the Nasdaq Global Market to the Nasdaq Capital Market effective September 18, 2026, after failing to regain the $1.00 minimum bid price by the September 14, 2026 initial deadline. Nasdaq granted a second 180-day period, to March 15, 2027; compliance requires a $1.00 close for 10 consecutive business days. Any reverse split must occur at least 10 business days before that date. Trading continues under BIOX. Watch dilution and split-ratio risk.
